tips.text: Reach Vox Solaris Rank 1 and buy the five Gyromag Systems before you start bounties; Profit-Taker costs far more.
Expect to farm Gyromag Systems and Scintillant yourself; neither can be traded.
Finish every bonus objective; it adds a reward roll from the final-stage table, the best odds for your part.
Run the longest bounty in each bracket; every stage past the first is another roll.
Stay past stage 1; leaving to reroll wastes the run because it never holds a part.
Wait until you can survive level 40-60 Deimos bounties; the Chassis part cannot drop from an easier tier.
Start the next bounty from Mother in the field instead of flying back to the Necralisk.
Skip resource boosters and Resourceful Retriever for the parts; they do not apply to bounty rewards.
Swap Viral for another damage type; Deimos Infested are immune to it.
Buy the three refined-resource blueprints (Otak, Smokefinger, Suumbaat) before the bounty grind; each craft makes a batch, so you need only a few.
Start each component the moment its blueprint and resources are ready; the three 12-hour timers can overlap.
Check whether Fass or Vome is up before gathering resources that depend on the Cambion cycle.
Farm other Deimos rewards and let the parts drop on the way; many players never target-farmed them.
Players report one to two hours with Vox Solaris done and a known Scintillant spot, about five without.
